title: MT-Eval: A Multi-Turn Capabilities Evaluation Benchmark for Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It was designed to evaluate multi-turn conversational abilities of Large Language Models across four categories: recollection, expansion, refinement, and follow-up.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as it was not a subject of its investigation.
